# continuous-delivery-scripts

> Reusable Git-based CI/CD tools for semantic release automation, changelogs, SPDX SBOMs, third-party IP (TPIP) licence reporting, copyright and licence headers, and secrets checks. Language plugins let teams keep their choice of CI provider.

## Task guides

- [Documentation overview](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/): Find the right tool for a delivery task.
- [Generate an SPDX SBOM](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/generating-an-spdx-sbom.html): Prerequisites and SPDX tag-value outputs.
- [Third-party IP and licence reporting](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/third-party-ip-reporting.html): Generate and review TPIP licence reports.
- [Automate releases](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/automating-releases.html): Calculate, tag and publish a release.
- [Generate changelogs](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/managing-changelogs.html): Build release notes from news fragments.
- [Manage source licence headers](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/licence-header-management.html): Update copyright and SPDX notices.
- [Check for secrets](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/checking-for-secrets.html): Scan Git-tracked files against the registry.

## Reference

- [All task guides](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/guides/index.html): Guides for every packaged command.
- [API reference](https://armmbed.github.io/continuous-delivery-scripts/api.html): Generated Python interfaces.
- [Source and README](https://github.com/ARMmbed/continuous-delivery-scripts): Current source, installation and CLI command table.

The GitHub Pages site is regenerated on release, so the repository may contain newer guides than the published pages.
